zh.title: Airbus A350F 完成首飛　啟動貨機認證飛行測試
zh.summary: 首架 A350F 測試機 MSN 700 於 9 月 29 日完成 4 小時 10 分鐘首飛，後續將與第二架測試機共同進行認證測試。
body: Airbus 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日宣布，首架 A350F 貨機測試機 MSN 700 已完成首次飛行。這架裝有專用測試儀器的航機由 Airbus 測試團隊操作，飛行時間為 4 小時 10 分鐘，最高飛行高度達 25,000 呎。
首飛主要驗證基本適航性、操縱特性與核心系統。Airbus 表示，團隊先以直接操縱模式測試，再於確認實際表現符合預測模型後，啟用具飛行包絡保護的正常模式；機組也檢查增壓、通訊與導航系統。
此次首飛啟動計畫約 10 個月、400 飛行小時的測試，目標為取得歐洲航空安全總署（EASA）型別認證。MSN 700 將著重性能、操縱特性與自動駕駛，MSN 701 則負責系統、煙霧偵測及冷熱環境測試。這是認證前的開發進度，尚非客戶交付或商業營運。
A350F 搭載 Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 發動機。Airbus 公布的設計性能為最高 111 公噸載重、最遠 8,700 公里航程；截至 2026 年 8 月底，該機型累計取得 14 家已公開客戶的 115 架訂單。

en.title: Airbus A350F completes maiden flight and begins certification testing
en.summary: A350F test aircraft MSN 700 completed a four-hour, ten-minute maiden flight on September 29, ahead of a two-aircraft certification campaign.
body: Airbus announced on September 29, 2026 that its first A350F freighter test aircraft, MSN 700, had completed its maiden flight. An Airbus test crew flew the instrumented aircraft for four hours and ten minutes, reaching 25,000 feet.

The flight checked basic airworthiness, handling and core systems. Airbus said the crew began in direct law and activated normal law with flight envelope protection after confirming that measured behaviour matched predictive models. Pressurisation, communications and navigation were also evaluated.

The planned campaign spans approximately ten months and 400 flight hours, aiming for EASA type certification. MSN 700 will concentrate on performance, handling and autopilot tests; MSN 701 will cover systems, smoke detection and hot- and cold-weather testing. The milestone precedes certification, customer deliveries and commercial operations.

The A350F uses Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines. Airbus lists a design payload of up to 111 tonnes and range of up to 8,700 kilometres. At the end of August 2026, it had 115 orders from 14 disclosed customers.

sources.name: Airbus — A350F first flight and test programme

facts.claim: Airbus announced on 2026-09-29 that A350F MSN 700 completed its maiden flight, lasting 4h10m and reaching 25,000 feet.
Initial checks covered airworthiness, handling and systems; the crew moved from direct law to normal law and tested pressurisation, communications and navigation.
Planned ten-month/400-flight-hour campaign aims for EASA type certification; MSN 700 covers handling, autopilot and performance while MSN 701 covers systems, smoke detection and hot/cold conditions.
A350F uses Trent XWB-97 engines; design payload up to 111 tonnes and range up to 8,700 km; 115 orders from 14 disclosed customers as of end-August 2026.
